condition: new secondary nocturnal bedwetting 4 nights weekly over 5 weeks in an 8-year-old child previously dry all night since age 5
level_rationale: Five weeks of new involuntary nighttime bedwetting 4 nights a week in an 8-year-old girl who had already learned to stay dry all night at age 5 describes secondary nocturnal bedwetting warranting a routine outpatient physician visit for urinalysis to exclude urinary tract infection or new-onset glycosuria, constipation and sleep history review, and behavioral guidance rather than unguided self-care alone or emergency care, whereas waking up 1 time last Saturday night and walking to the bathroom to pee represents normal intact nocturnal bladder arousal needing no medical care.
